prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption/new_screen, choose_path/copy, choose_path/layout, finish/hint, finish/redesign, and sign_in/reorder, as each has only 1 test.
Home wait_info changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Predictions were consistently too high across tests compared to measured and noise-corrected results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: -0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, hint: -1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -3.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +0.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Redesign Adoption Certificate Card Layout: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a stage layout with clear visual confirmation during creation. (why: Adoption has a low 60.9% conversion rate. A stage layout gives clearer visual framing for final pet confirmation.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Adoption Certificate: Move sign_in to occur after pet adoption so users create their account after personalizing their pet. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9%. Letting users personalize first builds investment before asking for sign in.)
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Guided Path Selection Story Flow: Rebuild the story and choose_path screens into a split narrative layout connecting intro lore directly to path choice. (why: Choose path has high median (8s) and mean time (514s) with a 76.2% conversion rate.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Existing Account Pet Sync Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure returning users that signing in restores saved pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making this the top support issue.)
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Progress Notification Toggle: Add a progress bar and background notification toggle on the waiting screen while the pet generates. (why: Home waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s; progress indicators help maintain user trust during generation.)
5: [adoption, incentive] Pick Friend Personality Trait Badges: Add mascot badges highlighting companion personality traits on the pick_friend selection screen. (why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%); personality trait badges help users select faster and build attachment.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Two-Column Path Choice Layout: Switch path selection screen to a two-column layout comparing custom pet creation and instant adoption side-by-side. (why: Choose path takes a mean 514s; side-by-side visual comparison reduces decision friction.)
7: [finish, notification] Desktop Pet Spawn Launcher Confirmation: Add desktop spawn troubleshooting hints and launch button to the finish screen. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing on desktop after setup, and finish conversion is 64.8%.)

scores.note: Target step has high drop-off, but previous redesigns consistently degraded conversion.
Reordering sign_in previously yielded negative lift (-0.5%).
High cost flow rebuild with no supporting evidence of success.
Config-only copy fix targeting top support issue (8 emails).
Two prior wait_info tests showed negligible effect (+0.3%).
Targets lowest-converting step (60.9%) with targeted visual guidance.
Supported by prior layout test showing +0.6% noise-corrected lift.
Directly addresses 3 support emails on second lowest converting step.
